verses.text: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye the name of Jehovah; Praise him, O ye servants of Jehovah,

segments.text: Praise ye Jehovah.
Praise ye the name of Jehovah;
Praise
him
, O ye servants of Jehovah,

verses.text: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of the house of our God.

segments.text: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah,
In the courts of the house of our God.

verses.text: Praise ye Jehovah; for Jehovah is good: Sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

segments.text: Praise ye Jehovah; for Jehovah is good:
Sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

verses.text: For Jehovah hath chosen Jacob unto himself, And Israel for his own possession.

segments.text: For Jehovah hath chosen Jacob unto himself,
And
Israel for his own possession.

verses.text: For I know that Jehovah is great, And that our Lord is above all gods.

segments.text: For I know that Jehovah is great,
And that our Lord is above all gods.

verses.text: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, that hath he done, In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;

segments.text: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, that hath he done,
In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;

verses.text: Who causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; Who maketh lightnings for the rain; Who bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries;

segments.text: Who causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth;
Who maketh lightnings for the rain;
Who bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries;

verses.text: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, Both of man and beast;

segments.text: Who smote the first-born of Egypt,
Both of man and beast;

verses.text: Who sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants;

segments.text: Who sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt,
Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants;

verses.text: Who smote many nations, And slew mighty kings,

segments.text: Who smote many nations,
And slew mighty kings,

verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, And Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan,

segments.text: Sihon king of the Amorites,
And Og king of Bashan,
And all the kingdoms of Canaan,

verses.text: And gave their land for a heritage, A heritage unto Israel his people.

segments.text: And gave their land for a heritage,
A heritage unto Israel his people.

verses.text: Thy name, O Jehovah, endureth for ever; Thy memorial name, O Jehovah, throughout all generations.

segments.text: Thy name, O Jehovah,
endureth
for ever;
Thy memorial
name
, O Jehovah, throughout all generations.

verses.text: For Jehovah will judge his people, And repent himself concerning his servants.

segments.text: For Jehovah will judge his people,
And repent himself concerning his servants.

verses.text: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.

segments.text: The idols of the nations are silver and gold,
The work of men’s hands.

verses.text: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

segments.text: They have mouths, but they speak not;
Eyes have they, but they see not;

verses.text: They have ears, but they hear not; Neither is there any breath in their mouths.

segments.text: They have ears, but they hear not;
Neither is there any breath in their mouths.

verses.text: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

segments.text: They that make them shall be like unto them;
Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

verses.text: O house of Israel, bless ye Jehovah: O house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah:

segments.text: O house of Israel, bless ye Jehovah:
O house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah:

verses.text: O house of Levi, bless ye Jehovah: Ye that fear Jehovah, bless ye Jehovah.

segments.text: O house of Levi, bless ye Jehovah:
Ye that fear Jehovah, bless ye Jehovah.

verses.text: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.

segments.text: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion,
Who dwelleth at Jerusalem.
Praise ye Jehovah.
